en.title: A more capable terminal, focused network tools
highlights: The TUI adapts to desktop and phone SSH terminals, with persistent node sorting and direct settings.
Profiles and shortcut rules have dedicated pages, and connection details distinguish original and sniffed domains.
Twelve network checks explain their limits; TUI can edit options and export the current report.
Recoverable installation errors remain visible with access to diagnostics.
en.known: Phone SSH devices, long-term memory behavior and the reported Windows code 68 incident remain unverified.
en.summary: Adaptive terminal controls, twelve network checks and visible update errors.

zh.title: 终端操作更灵活，网络工具更聚焦
highlights: TUI 适配桌面和手机 SSH 终端，支持持久节点排序与直接修改设置。
订阅和快捷规则拥有独立页面，连接详情区分原始域名与嗅探域名。
十二项网络检查说明测量边界，TUI 可直接编辑参数和导出当前报告。
可恢复的安装错误持续显示，并提供诊断入口。
zh.known: 手机 SSH 真机、长期内存表现及用户反馈的 Windows 代码 68 原因仍未完成验证。
zh.summary: 自适应终端、十二项网络检查，以及可见的更新错误。

en.title: Per-app exits on Android, a steadier Linux
highlights: Android per-app routing supports named rule groups, app search and chosen exits; app-specific exits need Android 10 or later.
Linux handles networks without IPv6, old autostart entries and rapid window resizing more reliably.
Node tests, updates and Geo downloads provide clearer errors and fallbacks.
Appearance settings and read-only pages stay usable during Claude protection.
en.known: Intermittent TLS failures and slow long-lived downloads were still being investigated.
en.summary: Refined app routing, updates and everyday connection management.

zh.title: 应用可指定出口，Linux 更稳
highlights: Android 应用分流支持命名规则组、搜索应用与指定出口；指定出口需 Android 10 及以上。
Linux 改进无 IPv6 网络启动、旧自启动入口与快速缩放窗口。
节点测速、更新与 Geo 下载的报错和回退更清晰。
Claude 保护期间，外观设置与只读页面继续可用。
zh.known: 当时仍在排查间歇性 TLS 失败与部分长连接下载慢速。
zh.summary: 应用分流、更新与日常连接管理进一步完善。

en.title: A refreshed interface
highlights: Refreshed interfaces on desktop, phone and tablet with a collapsible sidebar and consistent rule list.
Android per-app routing supports all, selected or excluded apps.
Subscription, Geo and client updates can try a separate direct route when the proxy is down.
Errors are shown by severity, with diagnostic export and issue shortcuts.

zh.title: 界面焕新
highlights: 桌面、手机与平板界面更新，侧栏可折叠，规则列表样式统一。
Android 应用分流支持全部应用、仅选中与排除选中。
订阅、Geo 与客户端更新在代理不可用时可尝试独立直连。
错误按影响程度展示，并提供导出诊断与新建 Issue 的入口。

zh.summary: 最低支持 Ubuntu 20.04，各页显示 Claude 保护状态；改进订阅格式兼容、IPv6 解析、Geo 恢复与 macOS 启动。

en.summary: Lowered the Ubuntu minimum to 20.04 and added Claude protection status across pages; improved subscription compatibility, IPv6 resolution, Geo recovery and macOS startup.

zh.summary: 修复断网启动后的联网恢复，完善 macOS 与 Tailscale 的 DNS 共存；加入订阅定时更新，统一规则拖动和下载恢复。

en.summary: Fixed recovery after starting offline and improved DNS coexistence with Tailscale on macOS; added scheduled subscription updates and refined rule dragging and download recovery.

zh.summary: 关闭窗口后释放独立界面进程以降低驻留内存；完善 GUI/CLI 状态同步、macOS 通知权限和更新通道。

en.summary: Released the separate UI process when closing the window to reduce resident memory; improved GUI/CLI state synchronization, macOS notification permissions and update channels.

zh.summary: 桌面安装包加入无需 GUI 的 cor 命令行，共用内核、订阅与设置；改进 Android VPN 连接、取消和更新反馈。

en.summary: Added the headless cor CLI to desktop packages, sharing the core, subscriptions and settings; improved Android VPN connection, cancellation and update feedback.

zh.summary: 统一桌面与 Android 的按钮、导航、弹窗和主题过渡；Claude 保护支持全局模式。

en.summary: Unified button, navigation, dialog and theme transitions across desktop and Android; added global-mode support to Claude protection.

zh.summary: 首次发布 Android 客户端，支持系统 VPN、应用分流、快捷磁贴和 APK 更新；适配手机与平板并保留桌面功能。

en.summary: Introduced the Android client with system VPN, per-app routing, quick-settings tiles and APK updates; adapted the interface for phones and tablets while retaining desktop features.

zh.summary: 桌面界面迁移至 Slint，统一字号、间距、主题与操作反馈；完善节点排序和下拉框选择。

en.summary: Moved the desktop interface to Slint with consistent typography, spacing, themes and interaction feedback; refined node sorting and dropdown selection.

zh.summary: Claude 保护在 macOS 接管系统 DNS 并保留局域网解析；修复登录自启后更新时安装助手随旧进程退出的问题。

en.summary: Claude protection now manages macOS system DNS while preserving local resolution; fixed the update helper exiting with the old app after login autostart.

zh.summary: 新增默认关闭的 Claude 保护，固定节点并配置 TUN、加密 DNS 与相关规则；后台监测偏离保护线路的连接。

en.summary: Added opt-in Claude protection with a fixed node, TUN, encrypted DNS and related rules; monitors connections that deviate from the protected route.

zh.summary: macOS 系统代理与 TUN 共用网络助手，减少重复授权；完善退出恢复、助手状态恢复及普通用户安装。

en.summary: Shared the macOS network helper between system proxy and TUN to reduce repeated authorization; improved exit cleanup, helper state recovery and installation by standard users.

zh.summary: 新增 A÷检测，整合 Claude 配置、本机网络和浏览器线索；报告区分风险、正常、辅助与未确认结果。

en.summary: Introduced A÷ checks combining Claude configuration, local network and browser signals; reports distinguish risks, normal findings, supporting signals and unconfirmed results.

zh.summary: 修复 macOS 从 TUN 切回系统代理后重启或更新误报端口占用；减少模式切换与登录自启的重复授权。

en.summary: Fixed false port conflicts during macOS restarts or updates after switching from TUN to system proxy; reduced repeated authorization during mode changes and login autostart.

zh.summary: 加入独立 DNS 覆盖与 IPv6 设置，优化连接保活和 Geo 加载；修复 macOS 自动更新的授权与应用替换。

en.summary: Added independent DNS override and IPv6 settings, refined connection keepalive and Geo loading, and fixed macOS update authorization and app replacement.

zh.summary: 修复 Linux 登录自启后的窗口与字体缩放，完善尺寸恢复；再次点击桌面图标可唤起已有窗口。

en.summary: Fixed Linux window and font scaling after login autostart, improved size restoration, and allowed the desktop icon to reopen the existing window.

zh.summary: 首次提供 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 的 macOS 原生客户端和 DMG，支持系统代理、托盘及登录后台启动。

en.summary: Introduced native macOS clients and DMG packages for Intel and Apple Silicon, with system proxy, tray and background login startup support.

zh.summary: 规则按订阅独立管理，支持编辑、启停、排序与恢复原序；快捷规则移入规则页并避免重复补入。

en.summary: Added per-subscription rule editing, toggling, reordering and order restoration; moved shortcut rules to the rules page and avoided duplicate additions.

zh.summary: 修复 Windows 普通用户自启权限与备用启动项反馈；改善配置原子保存、事务恢复和错误说明。

en.summary: Fixed Windows autostart permissions for standard users and fallback startup feedback; improved atomic configuration saves, transaction recovery and error details.

zh.summary: 修复 Ubuntu 自启托盘缺失、TUN 重复授权和窗口宽度恢复；加快 Windows 登录后的托盘显示。

en.summary: Fixed missing Ubuntu autostart tray icons, repeated TUN authorization and window width restoration; sped up the Windows tray after login.

zh.summary: Linux TUN 改用原生授权助手，修复 Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 权限流程和任务栏图标；补充真实流量验证。

en.summary: Moved Linux TUN to a native authorization helper, fixed Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 permissions and taskbar icons, and added real-traffic validation.

zh.summary: Linux 两架构改用 Ubuntu 22.04 构建以降低系统库要求；修复内核过早就绪判断，完善安装包扫描。

en.summary: Built both Linux architectures on Ubuntu 22.04 to lower system library requirements; fixed premature core readiness detection and refined installer scanning.

zh.summary: 新增 Windows 与 Linux ARM64 安装包；更新下载支持取消并清理临时文件。

en.summary: Added Windows and Linux ARM64 packages and cancellable update downloads with temporary-file cleanup.

zh.summary: 客户端和订阅统一更新入口，依次尝试内核代理、系统代理与直连；安装包重试后重新核对大小和 SHA256。

en.summary: Unified client and subscription updates with core proxy, system proxy and direct fallback; rechecks package size and SHA256 after retrying.

zh.summary: 更新检查加入代理回退和官方 Release 订阅源，细分网络错误；统一更新按钮并调整构建配置。

en.summary: Added proxy fallback and the official Release feed to update checks, with clearer network errors; unified update buttons and adjusted build settings.

zh.summary: 新增客户端内下载、SHA256 校验与自动安装，显示下载进度并在失败后允许重试；升级保留配置。

en.summary: Added in-app downloads, SHA256 verification and automatic installation with progress and retry on failure; upgrades preserve configuration.

zh.summary: 地区检测与 Linux 桌面集成迁移至原生 Rust，移除运行时脚本依赖；提供 Windows EXE 和 Debian/Ubuntu DEB 安装器。

en.summary: Moved region checks and Linux desktop integration to native Rust, removed runtime script dependencies, and provided Windows EXE and Debian/Ubuntu DEB installers.

zh.summary: 原始发行说明仅提示 Windows Defender 可能误报，未列出具体功能变更。

en.summary: The original notes only warn of possible Windows Defender false positives; no specific feature changes were listed.

zh.summary: 正式版加入启动及每六小时的更新检测，设置页可手动检查；提供独立新版本提示与语义版本比较。

en.summary: Added update checks at startup and every six hours, with manual checks in settings, a separate update notice and semantic version comparison.
